verbs.name: voiceover.start
verbs.description: Start one authenticated Timeline voiceover take on an unlocked current audio track. `request_id` and `expected_revision` are both required: Cut binds the selected start or In/Out range to that exact revision before it reserves the private microphone source or creates any WAV. A live exact retry checks the original caller/request/track/range owner before the current revision, so it can reattach after ordinary project edits; a new target still needs the current revision and a different B is refused while A is active. The server issues one memory-only opaque owner claim, bound to that request and Timeline caller; every later tick, Stop, Cancel, and Out observation must present it. Only the explicit `voiceover_start_retry_rejected` response code proves no matching owner survived and pre-admission was refused, so only it permits the UI to discard its non-secret retry identity. A changed request id payload, foreign caller, stale revision, locked/non-audio/removed track, unavailable selected microphone, or a host whose Record doctor has not admitted native capture is refused. The server owns readiness, the visual count-in, sealed WAV verification, Preview correlation, atomic asset-plus-clip placement, and the one Undoable project history operation. Direct microphone monitoring is always off.

start_ms.description: Playhead time, or In when out_ms is also supplied.

out_ms.description: Optional Out. It must be strictly after start_ms and stops on Preview's observed program playhead, not a wall clock.

owner_session_id.description: Optional opaque session id from a prior active response-loss retry. It is not a capability and cannot control a take by itself.

verbs.result: {schema, phase, request_id, accepted_revision, audio_track, start_ms, out_ms, countdown_remaining_ms?, direct_monitoring=off, owner_claim?, terminal?, placement?} — phase is waiting_for_microphone, countdown, starting_playback, recording, finishing, finished, or placed. An active status returns one opaque memory-only owner_claim {session_id,capability}; send it only to the next voiceover lifecycle call, never log or persist capability. No microphone endpoint, WAV path, or captured bytes is public. placed returns exactly one {asset_id,clip_id,op_id,already_applied}; that atomic project operation is the one history Undo for the finished take.

verbs.name: voiceover.tick
verbs.description: Advance the server-owned voiceover lifecycle. It observes real microphone readiness, projects the count-in, sends the correlated Preview seek/playback request at the boundary, validates Preview's latest request/fingerprint/epoch acknowledgement before recording, and places only a sealed accepted WAV as one atomic asset-plus-clip operation. The active Timeline caller must present its exact opaque owner claim. The UI normally calls this while a visible take is active. It never starts or simulates capture on an unadmitted host.
verbs.result: Same voiceover lifecycle projection as voiceover.start. `finishing` means the server is waiting for native finalization; only `placed` means the one asset and one clip are durable.

verbs.name: voiceover.stop
verbs.description: Request the first normal Stop for the active Timeline voiceover take. The active Timeline caller must present its exact opaque owner claim. Stop is idempotent by the server-owned terminal journal; it begins native finalization but does not imply that a WAV is usable or placed. Continue voiceover.tick until a finished or placed projection arrives.
verbs.result: Same voiceover lifecycle projection. A normal Stop that produced samples progresses through finishing and then exactly one atomic placement; a zero-sample or failed take is reported honestly and creates no timeline edit.

verbs.name: voiceover.cancel
verbs.description: Cancel the active Timeline voiceover take. The active Timeline caller must present its exact opaque owner claim. Cancel wins over a later Stop or Out observation, removes only the server-owned unsealed artifact after native finalization, and never creates an asset, clip, or project history operation.
verbs.result: Same voiceover lifecycle projection. A successful cancelled terminal has no placement and no Undo entry; a cleanup failure remains an explicit terminal error rather than being called cancelled.

verbs.name: voiceover.observe_playhead
verbs.description: Report the program Preview's observed playhead for the active Timeline voiceover. The active Timeline caller must present its opaque owner claim and the exact request_id, request_fingerprint, and latest bridge_epoch that started Preview playback. With an accepted Out, Cut makes the first observed playhead at or beyond Out the one normal Stop request. It never estimates Out from the count-in or microphone wall clock.
verbs.result: Same voiceover lifecycle projection. A playhead before Out leaves recording active; at/after Out requests the single normal Stop and then waits for finalization.
